fields.System.Title: CNT-5 — Full physical count
fields.System.Description:
Purpose

Count the entire warehouse at once, with operations stopped — for go-live, for audit, or when
cycle counting has lost credibility.

Scope

In. Warehouse freeze, counting every location, reconciling and posting, unfreezing.

Out. Statutory audit reporting formats. Stock valuation.

Design notes

Count with everything frozen, or with everything running — never half and half. A partial
freeze produces variances that are indistinguishable from real ones, which is worse than not
counting.

The freeze must be genuinely complete. No receipts, no picks, no putaway, no replenishment,
no transfers dispatching or arriving. Every in-flight task must be completed or cancelled
before the count starts, and CNT-501 needs an acceptance criterion for each of those paths.

This is also the go-live procedure. Opening stock should come from a full physical count,
not from the old system's numbers — if those were reliable, part of the reason for the new
system would not exist. Load the result as receipts against a GO-LIVE reason code so the
ledger reconciles from day one. See [doc 08 §8](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md).

Do a verification count a week later on a sample of locations. It tells you whether the
opening figures were right, and it is far cheaper to find out in week one than in month six.

Risks

| Risk | Reference |
|---|---|
| Incomplete freeze contaminating every variance | [doc 09 §6.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Opening stock taken from the old system | [doc 09 §11.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Opening stock loaded without movements | [doc 09 §11.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| No verification count afterwards | [doc 08 §8](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md) |
